list_child.name: list_charter_trips
list_child.desc: Returns the full list of charter trips currently on the books, whether they are upcoming, underway, or already finished. Use this to get a complete view of the schedule.

get_child.name: get_charter_trip
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single charter trip record by its identifier, including its status and departure details. Use this instead of scanning the whole trip list when you already know which trip you need.

list_parent.name: list_anglers
list_parent.desc: Returns every angler who has booked with the charter, past and present. This is the full customer roster on file.

get_parent.name: get_angler
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single angler record by identifier, pulling up their contact and booking details. Use this when you need one specific customer's information.

delete_child.name: cancel_charter_trip
delete_child.desc: Permanently removes a charter trip record from the schedule, and this action cannot be undone once it runs. Only use this for trips that were never going to happen or were logged in error.

set_enum.name: set_trip_status
set_enum.desc: Moves a charter trip to a new status, covering booked, underway, completed, or cancelled. This keeps the schedule accurate as trips actually happen or fall through.

set_bool.name: flag_weather_hold
set_bool.desc: Marks a charter trip as being on weather hold, meaning it should not sail until conditions clear. Use this when a storm or rough seas puts a trip in doubt.

set_ref.name: rebook_angler
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a charter trip from one angler to another, which comes up when a booking gets transferred or a group changes its lead. The trip keeps its full history after the move.

send.name: call_angler
send.desc: Places a call to the angler associated with a charter trip. Use this when a trip needs a direct conversation instead of a written message.

sort.sup_phrase: the charter trip with the earliest departure
sort.ord_phrase: the charter trip with the {ord} earliest departure
